title: Montgomery County Police consent searches

fields.name: district
fields.meaning: the police district where it happened (the county calls the field "District of occurrence")
notes: The districts are police districts. Montgomery County Police names six of them by their stations: district 1 is Rockville, district 2 is Bethesda, district 3 is Silver Spring, district 4 is Wheaton, district 5 is Germantown and district 6 is Montgomery Village.
These are Montgomery County, Maryland's own police records, published by the county. They are not statewide Maryland records.
